entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-09
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • launchSettings.json properties not working on CLI #50157
  • NullReferenceException in ApplyManagedCodeUpdates when running dotnet or aspire watch against Aspire AppHost #50156
  • [Static Web Assets] Respect custom content-type mappings #50152
  • [Static Web Asssets] Change the Vary header that we add in ApplyCompressionNegotiation to be Accept-Encoding #50150
  • [Static Web Assets] Remove Accept-Ranges header from DefineStaticWebAssetEndpoints #50148
  • Validate `dotnet test --arch ...` behavior on solution #50147

Closed

  • [dotnet run][Regression] Message about launchSettings.json is no longer produced #50111
  • Publishing for win fails with unhelpful error message #3401
    Backlog
  • Add or document a way to disable JS Modules in the Razor SDK #34487
  • Static web asset paths are absolute in a .NET 7 MVC project #31194
  • Allow disabling blazor css scopes without disabling bundling of .razor.css files #46466
  • Unable to disable GZip compression while keeping Brotli compression #46320
  • Unable to build project which depends on package containing pre-compressed static web assets #40413
  • Conflicting assets with the same target path #22702
  • Unable to build project using VS 17.14 “DiscoverPrecompressedAssets” task failed unexpectedly #49180

PullRequests

Created

  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 140: Build ID 2768547 #50155
    Area-Common templates
  • fix #50008 by bumping precedence so the 10 template is treated as the primary #50154
    Area-Common templates
  • Fix ContentTypeProvider to respect custom content-type mappings precedence #50153
  • Fix Vary header in Static Web Assets compression negotiation to use Accept-Encoding #50151
  • Remove Accept-Ranges header from DefineStaticWebAssetEndpoints #50149
  • Delete unused internal extension method #50146

Merged

  • ensure that the run commands operates on minimal verbosity by default #50114
    Area-CLI, Area-Run

Updated

  • Use real SdkResolver APIs to set .NET environment variables for .NET TaskHost purposes #50091
  • Allow users to override packaging implementation in generated tool packages #50015
    Area-Tools
  • [StaticWebAssets] Process collection properties with amortized allocation #49682
    Area-AspNetCore
  • [wasm] Don't call .NET runtime if browser refresh script for HotReload is missing #50138
    Area-AspNetCore, 10.0.1xx
  • Add test for dotnet test with UseAppHost=false in MTP #50109
  • Add better error messages for dotnet test with file/directory arguments in Microsoft Testing Platform (MTP) #50108
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #50073
    Area-CodeFlow
